SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm the intended depth, hook system and tackle provision. This is a different trip type from offshore trolling even though the operator and island destination are shared; pack for the chosen boat and method.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Palau

Non-Palauan anglers need a Koror State fishing permit in Koror waters. A permit does not open conservation areas or docks to fishing, and other states require separate checks.

  • Koror visitor fishing permitKoror visitor fishing permit
Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • The Koror visitor fishing permit does not allow fishing from docks.
  • Do not fish in conservation areas.
  • Do not catch or harass sharks.
  • Check the charter's exact fishing area against Koror's conservation-area rules official regulations ↗

Full Palau licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
